newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOKYO RUBBER FUTURES END LOWER ON STRONG YEN.
newsitem.headline: TOKYO RUBBER FUTURES END LOWER ON STRONG YEN.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures extended early losses to end lower across the board on Monday after lacklustre trading, pressured by the stronger yen and falls in other commodity prices in Japan, traders said.
Prices ranged from 2.8 yen to 3.7 yen per kg lower. Benchmark January was off 2.8 yen at 119.6 yen.

"In addition to the yen's strength, losses in other commodity futures like grain futures dampened market sentiment," one trader said. "Given thin speculative interest partly due to (Japan's) Obon holidays, rubber prices are likely to drift weaker for the time being," he said.
